answers.reason: The president chairs the university's central bodies, which includes the senate.
The budget planning round is a central body dealing with funds, which the president as head of university leadership helps oversee.
The president is not mentioned as a member of the appointment committee.
The faculty council is led and chaired by the dean, not the president.
The study commission is a faculty-level body and the president operates at the university leadership level.
The examination board handles faculty-level individual examination matters.
The internal research funding round is managed at the faculty level.
The module revision working group operates at the degree programme level within a faculty.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a faculty-level matter.
Orientation week planning is a faculty-level student activity.
